rect_tube.title: Carbon steel square and rectangular tubes for general structure (STKR)
rect_tube.edition: JIS G 3466:2015 as amended by Amendment 1 (2016) and Amendment 2 (2018), i.e. the text titled 'JIS G 3466 : 2018' on kikakurui.com (table page headers print 'G 3466:2015'). Newer editions JIS G 3466:2021 and :2025 exist; their size table was confirmed identical only via the JISF 2024-12-20 revision draft (see source).
rect_tube.form: [A, B, t] mm: outer sides A >= B and wall t
rect_tube.source: read from https://kikakurui.com/g3/G3466-2018-01.html (Table 5 square, Table 6 rectangular); every row's printed unit mass recomputed with the standard's formula and matched; cross-checked against https://www.jisf.or.jp/business/standard/jis/documents/docs_kouzai_1600_JISG3466_20241220.pdf (a draft of the 2025 revision, same rows)
rect_tube.note: Checked by the QA department on the kikakurui table images: every row count (Table 5: 53, Table 6: 59) and the sizes it named: 40x40x1.6, 40x40x2.3, 60x60x3.2, 90x90x2.3, 100x100x9.0, 150x150x4.5, 200x200x4.5, 250x250x9.0, 350x350x12.0, 50x20x1.6, 75x20x2.3, 100x20x1.6, 100x50x4.5, 150x75x3.2, 200x100x4.5, 300x200x6.0, 400x200x12.0, 80x40x2.3. Newer editions (2021, 2025) were not read; the 2025 draft has the same sizes.
rect_tube.unit_mass_note: unit_mass_kg_m: the unit mass printed in Tables 5 and 6, same order as sizes, as machine-read from the JISF draft text and the same on the kikakurui table images; the standard computes it as W = 0.0157 t (A + B - 3.287 t) kg/m (t, A, B in mm, density 7.85 g/cm3), rounded to 3 significant figures

round_tube.title: Carbon steel tubes for general structure (STK)
round_tube.edition: JIS G 3444:2015 as amended by Amendment 1 (2016), i.e. the text titled 'JIS G 3444 : 2016' on kikakurui.com (table page headers print 'G 3444:2015'). Newer editions JIS G 3444:2021 and :2025 exist; their size table was confirmed identical only via the JISF 2024-12-20 revision draft (see source).
round_tube.form: [D, t] mm: outside diameter D and wall t
round_tube.source: read from https://kikakurui.com/g3/G3444-2016-01.html (Table 6); every row's printed unit mass recomputed with the standard's formula and matched; cross-checked against https://www.jisf.or.jp/business/standard/jis/documents/docs_kouzai_1400_JISG3444_20241220.pdf (a draft of the 2025 revision, same rows)
round_tube.note: Checked by the QA department on the kikakurui table images: the row count (128) and the sizes it named: 21.7x2.0, 76.3x3.2, 165.2x4.5, 216.3x8.2, 355.6x9.0, 457.2x16.0, 558.8x9.0, 609.6x16.0, 812.8x12.0, 1016.0x22.0. Newer editions (2021, 2025) were not read; the 2025 draft has the same sizes.
round_tube.unit_mass_note: unit_mass_kg_m: the unit mass printed in Table 6, same order as sizes, as machine-read from the JISF draft text and the same on the kikakurui table images; the standard computes it as W = 0.02466 t (D - t) kg/m (t, D in mm, density 7.85 g/cm3), rounded to 3 significant figures
